Jasmine — thanks for the attachments and timeline. Couple of clarifying questions from our security review: 

1) DPA deletion guarantees — your note about "best-effort purge within 90 days of deletion request" is OK as a starting point, but we need the DPA to be explicit for primary data vs backups. Can you confirm: primary data deletion within 7 days of written request; complete removal from backups within 90 days (with a documented snapshot schedule)?

2) Backups and disaster recovery — what is your RTO/RPO for hosted customers on the Redwood API? Do backups include full KV caches or only persistent storage?

3) KMS / key control — confirm if customers can bring their own key (BYOK) for Private deployments and whether hosted API keys are tenant-isolated.

4) SIG/CAIQ evidence — for a few questions (e.g., 3.2.a encryption at rest, 8.4 access revocation) we need sample evidence (policy excerpts or control screenshots) rather than free-text answers. Can Kimberly provide a short bundle?

5) Demo / acceptance — we'll need a recorded walkthrough of the hosted API controls (15–20 minutes) and an authenticated session that shows how to run a deletion request end-to-end.

Please let us know if the 7/90 deletion split is acceptable; if not, propose exact wording we can add to the MAP & DPA. Attached is our security intake with a few items prefilled.

Attachments: FinCloud_Security_Checklist_prefill.xlsx

Best,
Arjun Patel

Subject: Re: MAP + evidence orchestration: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA clarifications

Arjun / Rachel — thanks, this is helpful. Short answers and a concrete MAP update below.

1) Data deletion windows (final proposal for MAP / DPA):
- Primary data: confirmed deletion within 7 business days of a verified written request; we will return a deletion confirmation certificate.
- Backups / snapshots: retained on a rolling 90-day cycle; we will commit in the DPA to expunge deleted objects from incremental/rolling backups within 90 days of the deletion confirmation. We will document snapshot cadence (weekly full, daily incremental).

2) RTO / RPO: for hosted Redwood API: RTO = 4 hours, RPO = 1 hour for primary service components (control plane failover and data plane failover). Backup retention does not change the RPO. KV caches are not persisted to long-term backups; persistent customer objects are stored in encrypted object storage.

3) KMS / keys:
- Private deployment (on-prem / VPC): BYOK is supported; customers can manage keys via their KMS and we support KMIP/HSM integrations.
- Hosted: tenant key isolation is provided for encryption-at-rest; we manage keys by default but can offer customer-managed keys for enterprise Dedicated customers under a separate contract.

4) SIG/CAIQ evidence bundle: Kimberly will provide a zip of policy excerpts and anonymized screenshots for the requested controls. Delivery ETA: 2026-09-22 (per MAP).

5) Demo & deletion run-through: Marcus will record a 15-minute walkthrough showing the deletion flow and will provide an authenticated session for one test tenant. Delivery ETA: 2026-09-22.

Updated MAP milestones (finalized for your review):
- 2026-09-15: Intake clarified & owners assigned (COMPLETE).
- 2026-09-22: Evidence bundle delivered (SOC2 artifacts, SIG/CAIQ exports, deletion demo).
- 2026-09-29: Technical review call + open items closure.
- 2026-10-06: MAP sign-off + DPA countersign (target).

Doc for redlines: we will review your DPA and push a DocuSign envelope with our counterpoints. Please expect a redline within 3 business days of receiving your DPA draft.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx

Thanks — let me know if we should tighten the deletion window; we aimed to balance operational constraints and your need for predictable purge timelines.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
